sections.heading: Assurance
paragraphs: The August 2026 internal security audit sampled 42 control executions and closed its one minor supplier finding by 2026-09-03. A previous 2025 stale-key weakness was fixed and re-tested on 2026-01-18.
NIST access, monitoring, backup and recovery practices were independently checked against operation logs.

sections.heading: Privacy review
paragraphs: The youth-wallet DPIA has an approved scope dated 2026-09-10. Fieldwork and sign-off are planned for 2026-11-30. No completed DPIA was available at the October review.
